facts.value: Meet one of the following options from Section A: One year of high school American history; Minimum SAT II subject test score of 560 on American history/social studies; One transferable 3-credit college American history course.

Meet one of the following options from Section B: One year of high school social science (e.g., European history, world history, economics, sociology, geography, government, psychology or anthropology); Minimum SAT II subject test score of 580 on world history; One transferable 3-credit college social science course.
Meet one of the following: One year (or a combination of two semesters) of high school fine arts or career and technical education; One transferable 3-credit college fine arts course.
